narrative.overview: Every series is a part of the manual and every post a chapter. Readers locate themselves by numbering: running head, chapter number, numbered sections matched to the TOC, and a home page that is the manual's full table of contents. The frame belongs to the manual; the reading column stays quiet.
keyCharacteristics: One teal accent for 'you are here' and 'clickable'

rules.name: One Accent
rules.body: Teal is the only interface accent; states are marks, not color fields.

rules.name: Lines Replace Shadows
rules.body: 1px rule separates peers, 1px ink closes a unit, 2px ink opens a home section.

rules.name: No Negative Tracking
rules.body: letter-spacing 0 for body, at most 0.01em for headings.

dos: Make every number match its counterpart
donts: No cards with shadows, glass, gradients
No emoji or Unicode glyphs as icons
